title: Match the problem to the fix
summary: Common ranking-system problems and their standard fixes.

prompts.text: Items shown at the top get clicked more regardless of quality
New videos never get shown, so they never get engagement data
The top ten results are near-duplicates of each other
The model only learns from items it already chose to show

options.text: Train with position as a feature and fix it at serving, or estimate propensities from randomised slots
Re-rank for diversity, for example with maximal marginal relevance
Reserve a small share of traffic for exploration and log propensities
Content-based features and a new-item boost or bandit exploration
